4050-7084-8347.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-4772-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1869-1916-2034.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {4}{G}.
Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Titan with haste.
The token Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Titan.
The nontoken Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Titan trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Titan token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Titan from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-4460-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4460-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1497-2173-4699-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3634-3821-5921.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax minus {1} if applicable.
3634-3821-5921.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Venser either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Venser enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3196-4413.description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying {3}{B}.
When Last Voyage of the _____ enters, it triggers, returning Kederekt Leviathan from your graveyard to the battlefield with Last Voyage of the _____ attached.
When Kederekt Leviathan enters, it triggers, returning all nonland permanents to their owner's hands.
Last Voyage of the _____'s last ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kederekt Leviathan.
Repeat each turn.

3698-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
3698-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

618-1734-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2919-3197-3641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-3641.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3388-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Moritte of the Frost on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Moritte of the Frost do not have summoning sickness.
3388-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Moritte of the Frost.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Moritte of the Frost.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

2059-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.
2059-5470.description:
Create a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Village Bell-Ringer copy.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3542-6057.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}.
1170-3542-6057.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}.
Cast Cage of Hands by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cage of Hands spell.
Activate Cage of Hands by paying {1}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2617-4050-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
2617-4050-4613-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of another nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-2232-5651.notablePrerequisites:
Eladamri does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You control at least two additional untapped creatures, one of which must be a nontoken, nonartifact creature.
You have a nonartifact creature card in hand or a nonartifact creature card on top of your library.
1636-2232-5651.description:
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Eladamri by paying {G}, tapping it and two other creatures you control, revealing a nonartifact creature card either from your hand or from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning one of the other creatures tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1311-1506-3341.notablePrerequisites:
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness.
Burning Anger attached to Charnelhoard Wurm.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.
1311-1506-3341.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Charnelhoard Wurm by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to an opponent.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Mobilize to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Mobilize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

578-2043-3499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
578-2043-3499.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Metalworker that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Repeat using the Metalworker token instead.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

1135-1162.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1135-1162.description:
Cast Kazuul's Fury by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing Angelic Enforcer, dealing damage equal to Angelic Enforcer's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

643-2438-4338.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

938-1582-3263-3771-4659.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
938-1582-3263-3771-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard for {1}.
Ominous Roost triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.
